name: Strategies tour: E1 breaks down in Weesen (+20 steps)
description: For the tour 'Walensee: strategies on the Zug-Weg-Diagramm', not a study condition. Train 0 (E1) stands for 20 steps at step 18 in Weesen, before the single-track section it is planned to cross first. Keeping the plan makes the other two wait for it (about 50 min summed lateness); a Prioritized Planning re-plan lets E2 overtake in Weesen and W1 through the section first (about 24 min) — the case where re-planning clearly beats the timetable. The saving shrinks the longer the operator waits (from step ~31 on). Found by a search over train, step and duration (docs/plans/widget-e1-combined-actions.md).

events.label: Breakdown in Weesen (+20 steps)
events.description: A train stops in Weesen, just before the single-track section it was due to cross first. The trains behind and ahead of it are timed around it.
